context: The tray is role=region with an accessible name; not a dialog, not modal, no focus trap. A persistently mounted polite live region announces selection changes, debounced so multi-select produces one announcement. Appearance never moves focus. The enabled/disabled transition of the primary action is part of the same announcement. Escape collapses without clearing, with a defined return-focus rule that never leaves focus on a removed control. The collapse control is a real button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
description:
Accessibility slice for the shared tray, separate from geometry.

Precedent to reuse: QueryHeatmap already runs a polite live region for focused-cell announcements (QueryHeatmap.tsx:145-146, 441-448). Disabled reasons are exposed via aria-describedby (PlatformIndex.tsx:961, Query.tsx:900), NOT an accessible-name suffix - an earlier revision stated the opposite and was wrong.

anti_patterns.dont: Switch capped or locked checkboxes to aria-disabled so the description becomes reachable
anti_patterns.why: it adds dozens of inert tab stops, requires click and keyboard suppression on controlled Preact checkboxes, and breaks .disabled assertions in Query, PlatformIndex, Compare, QueryHeatmap and BenchmarkIndex tests

anti_patterns.dont: collapse on Escape without a return-focus rule
anti_patterns.instead: define where focus goes when the focused control is removed
anti_patterns.why: collapsing can destroy the currently focused element

anti_patterns.instead: make worktree-create BRANCH=... WORKTREE_PATH=... then make agent-write-preflight
anti_patterns.why: AGENTS.md makes the primary clone read-only for agents

anti_patterns.dont: mount the live region only when a selection exists
anti_patterns.why: a region inserted at announcement time is frequently not announced

anti_patterns.dont: move focus to the tray when it appears
anti_patterns.instead: leave focus on the control the reader just operated
anti_patterns.why: stealing focus interrupts multi-select and disorients screen-reader users

anti_patterns.dont: put the disabled reason in the accessible name
anti_patterns.why: that is the shipped pattern in PlatformIndex and Query

preserves.behavior: Disabled reasons are exposed via aria-describedby (PlatformIndex.tsx:961, Query.tsx:900), not an accessible-name suffix. Follow the shipped pattern.
